display_long_description:
**Spira — Playful 3D painting, wherever you are!** 🍦

Bring 3D creations to life with intuitive hand controls. Pick from a library of charming templates—cupcakes, cozy room, characters—and enjoy creativity, anywhere you are. Spira is travel mode compatible on trains and airplanes! ✈️

[media]

**Designed for Hands** 👌

Use your hands to draw & color models! Intuitive gestures make the app instant to pick up and get going. 

[media]

**Tasty color palettes and patterns!** 🎨

Spira comes with ready-made color palettes, patterns and a metallic / matte 
selection.

[media]

**Draw & color anywhere** ✈️

Works with travel mode on trains and planes.

[media]
